firstrun.title: Set up your ledger
firstrun.lead: TILL found no ledger on this machine. Pick a door: nothing is created until you do.
firstrun.lead_existing_one: This machine already carries one ledger. These doors add another; your existing books stay untouched.
firstrun.lead_existing_many: This machine already carries {count} ledgers. These doors add another; your existing books stay untouched.

create.label: Create a new ledger
create.hint: Start a fresh set of books with the Swiss KMU chart of accounts.

restore.label: Restore a backup
restore.hint: Load a .tillbackup file. Ids are re-minted into a fresh workspace; nothing is overwritten.
restore.pick_incompatible: Generation {generation} does not match this install. Install the matching release and restore it there.

adopt.label: Adopt an existing database
adopt.hint: Already have a TILL book on this machine? Choose the file and TILL opens it. It is never copied or moved.
adopt.path_hint: In the Finder: right-click the file, hold the Option key (⌥) and choose “Copy as Pathname”.
adopt.opening_body: TILL restarts briefly to open it. This only takes a moment.
adopt.opening_agents: Agents that are already connected see the new book once they restart.

error.book_path_pinned: This installation sets its own book. It cannot be changed here.
error.book_path_not_absolute: Enter the full path; it starts with a /.
error.book_not_found: There is no file at this path. Check the path and try again.
error.book_unreadable: TILL may not read and write this file. Check its permissions and try again.
error.not_a_till_database: That file is not a TILL book. It was left untouched. Choose another.
error.book_not_saved: TILL could not remember the book. Nothing was changed. Try again.
error.book_not_forgotten: TILL could not forget the book. Nothing was changed. Try again.
error.restart_unavailable: This installation cannot switch its book by itself. Nothing was changed.
error.fallback: That did not work. Nothing was changed. Try again.

unavailable.title: Your adopted book is not reachable
unavailable.missing: TILL cannot find the file any more: {path}. It may have been moved, or its drive is not connected.
unavailable.unopenable: TILL cannot open the file: {path}. A permission may be missing, or it is no longer a TILL book.
unavailable.nothing_written: TILL changed nothing and created no new book anywhere. Choose how to go on.
unavailable.forget_confirm: TILL only forgets where this book is. The file {path} stays as it is, and you can adopt it again later. TILL then opens this device's default book.

error.not_a_till_database: That file is not a TILL database. The file was left untouched. Pick another.
error.schema_newer_than_runtime: That database was written by a newer TILL. Update TILL, then try again. The file was not changed.
error.incompatible_schema_version: This backup comes from schema generation {backup}; this install runs generation {runtime}. Install the current release, restore the backup there, then upgrade on your own schedule. The backup was left untouched.
error.unrestorable_format: An export (.tillexport) is not a restore source. Choose a .tillbackup file.
error.unbalanced: Checked, but not balanced: generation {generation}, {entries} entries. TILL will not restore it. Choose another backup.

demo.lead: Want to look around with sample data first?
demo.hint: A demo workspace with sample postings. You can delete it later.

mode.label: Running as: {mode}
mode.up: till up (Studio, REST and MCP on one process)

scheduler.off: Scheduler off (recurring cadences fire only while till up runs).

residency.caveat: This session runs in a cloud environment: your books do not stay only on your machine while it runs. Back up at the end of the session and carry the file out.

FirstRun.title: First run
FirstRun.body: This is the first screen when TILL has no workspace open. You choose one of three doors: create a fresh workspace, restore one from a backup file, or adopt a TILL book that already lives on this machine. To adopt, TILL restarts briefly and then opens that book; the file stays where it is. Nothing is created silently, since each door confirms before it writes, and until you pick one, no books exist yet. When an adopted book is not reachable, this screen says so and offers to try again, choose another book or forget it.

residency.lead: Your books are a single file on this device. Nothing is sent. Disk encryption is the operating system's job (FileVault).
